instructions: Preserve screenshot UI and permission text; cover personal emails, avatar initials and expiry timestamps with opaque privacy blocks; add a numbered warm ivory and brown instruction header and orange control outlines.

steps.title: Start Gmail setup
steps.instruction: Click Authorize Gmail, then Continue to Gmail authorization.

steps.title: Testing-stage warning
steps.instruction: Continue only if Sentique invited you and you trust this app.

steps.title: Confirm your sender account
steps.instruction: Check the selected account, then click Continue.

steps.title: Allow the helper connection
steps.instruction: Review Connect to an external service, then click Continue.

steps.title: Authorize the Gmail sender
steps.instruction: Confirm the sender account, then click Authorize Gmail Account.

steps.title: Testing-stage warning
steps.instruction: Continue only if Sentique invited you and you trust this app.

steps.title: Confirm the account again
steps.instruction: Use the same sender account, then click Continue.

steps.title: Review Gmail sending access
steps.instruction: Review Send email on your behalf, then click Continue.

steps.title: Return to Property setup
steps.instruction: Go back to the original Property setup tab.

steps.title: Check the connection
steps.instruction: Click Check connection. Finish when Gmail connected appears.
